input: Investigate peer-to-peer lending platforms this week

gold.taskTitle: Investigate Peer-to-Peer Lending Platforms This Week
gold.taskDescription: Research and evaluate peer-to-peer lending platforms within the current week to reach a specific goal or decision.

questions.title: Are you investigating as a borrower or an investor?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to borrow money through a P2P platform or invest money to earn returns.

questions.title: What country or region are you based in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow down platforms that are legally available and relevant to them.

questions.title: What specific amount of money are you considering?
questions.description: Understand the rough sum the user plans to borrow or invest, as this affects which platforms are suitable.

questions.title: What is your primary goal by end of this week?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to pick a platform, open an account, make a first transaction, or just gather information.

questions.title: Have you used any P2P lending platform before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's prior experience to tailor the depth and technicality of the research plan.

questions.title: Are there specific risk levels you are comfortable with?
questions.description: Understand the user's risk tolerance, such as preference for secured loans, credit grades, or guaranteed return products.

questions.title: Are there platforms you already want compared or excluded?
questions.description: Find out if the user has specific platforms in mind to include or rule out from the investigation.
